details.label: Alert detail
details.text:
SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH 665 REMAINS VALID UNTIL 11 PM EDT THIS
EVENING FOR THE FOLLOWING AREAS

IN OHIO THIS WATCH INCLUDES 6 COUNTIES

IN EAST CENTRAL OHIO

CARROLL               COLUMBIANA            COSHOCTON
HARRISON              JEFFERSON OH          TUSCARAWAS

IN PENNSYLVANIA THIS WATCH INCLUDES 8 COUNTIES

IN SOUTHWEST PENNSYLVANIA

ALLEGHENY             WASHINGTON            WESTMORELAND

IN WEST CENTRAL PENNSYLVANIA

ARMSTRONG             BUTLER                INDIANA

IN WESTERN PENNSYLVANIA

BEAVER                LAWRENCE

IN WEST VIRGINIA THIS WATCH INCLUDES 2 COUNTIES

IN THE NORTHERN PANHANDLE OF WEST VIRGINIA

BROOKE                HANCOCK

THIS INCLUDES THE CITIES OF ALIQUIPPA, AMBRIDGE, BEAVER FALLS,
BUTLER, CADIZ, CANONSBURG, CARROLLTON, COLUMBIANA, COSHOCTON,
DOVER, EAST LIVERPOOL, ELLWOOD CITY, FOLLANSBEE, FORD CITY,
GREENSBURG, INDIANA, KITTANNING, LATROBE, MONACA, MURRYSVILLE,
NEW CASTLE, NEW KENSINGTON, NEW PHILADELPHIA,
PITTSBURGH METRO AREA, SALEM, STEUBENVILLE, WASHINGTON, WEIRTON,
AND WELLSBURG.
